sources.excerpt:
Recognized Student Organizations, from the University of Chicago Scavenger Hunt to Model UN, in addition to academic teams, sports club, arts groups, and more are funded by The University of Chicago Student Government. Student Government is made up of graduate and undergraduate students elected to represent members from their respective academic unit. It is led by an Executive Committee, chaired by a President with the assistance of two Vice Presidents, one for Administration and the other for Student Life, elected together as a slate by the student body each spring. Its annual budget is greater than $2 million.

## Fictional approval appendix
At the fictional Orvella Depot, it is for the Freight Registrar to approve standard cargo schedules. This approval authority applies only to standard cargo schedules at Orvella Depot. No other approval authority is described in this corpus.
